scheme_name: मध्यप्रदेश फसल विविधीकरण हेतु प्रोत्साहन योजना
scheme_name_english: Madhya Pradesh Crop Diversification Incentive Scheme
department: Kisan Kalyan and Agriculture Development Department, Government of Madhya Pradesh
beneficiary: Farmers and eligible implementing companies, firms or institutions as per scheme guidelines
benefits: Provides incentive or assistance for eligible crop diversification activities, encouraging alternative crops in place of wheat and paddy, including eligible horticulture crops.
eligibility: Eligibility is according to the scheme guidelines. Eligible companies, firms or institutions may work with farmers, provide agricultural guidance and support purchase arrangements for eligible crops.
required_documents: Details required under the current scheme guidelines
application_process: The applicant company, firm or institution submits an application to the Directorate of Farmers Welfare and Agriculture Development in the prescribed format.
source_type: MP Government CM Helpline Scheme Dashboard
